mimalloc.description: Global allocator backend mimalloc (configure with USE_MALLOC=mimalloc). Builds cleanly on MSVC/MinGW/Linux.

jemalloc.description: Global allocator backend jemalloc (configure with USE_MALLOC=jemalloc). Not buildable on every toolchain — e.g. GCC 16 MinGW.

tcmalloc.description: Global allocator backend tcmalloc (configure with USE_MALLOC=tcmalloc).
